This model is SKU34961 without soldered headers. SKU34960 (-M) is a distinct header option; its additional header geometry is not represented by this base model.

The official AA dimensions 17.39×32.35 mm differ from exact 172:320 aspect by approximately 0.0108% due to published dimensional precision. The native physical dimensions are preserved, with normalized UVs and clipped corners.

WS2812 GPIO8 is mapped only to the actual native LED package under the LCD stack. It is naturally occluded in the assembled view and becomes visible when the optical stack is separated for inspection.
The 36.28 mm LCM drawing height describes the main display body. Native component0 also includes folded flex extending to37.00 mm; these extents are not forced into agreement.
PMMA and adhesive names mention S3; they are reused mechanical parts inside the explicitly C5 assembly, not a substitution of an S3 circuit.

The STEP is an internal board/display assembly and contains no black enclosure. This model intentionally presents that internal assembly. Shipping enclosure, battery and camera accessories have not been reconstructed or certified.

SKU35417 is the no-camera package with battery; 35416 (-EN) omits the battery. SKU35419 (-C) and 35418 (-C-EN) add a camera. These packaging facts do not certify common hidden geometry. No battery or camera is invented here.

The 63.67×95.11 mm housing and 13.50/14.10 mm depth annotations are from the official camera -C dimension image. They are recorded separately and are not substituted for the native 61.00×92.44×13.40 mm internal assembly.

PWR is source geometry only pending exact runtime control semantics. Source component801 AS-BD108A93D13-50 has a camera-lens/FPC shape and is omitted from this explicitly no-camera base SKU; adjacent central EVA foam806 is also omitted because its applicability without that attachment is unverified. This geometric/photo identification does not certify a camera chip part number.
The source PMMA part name mentions P4; it is a reused mechanical part within the newly published assembly explicitly named ESP32-C5-TOUCH-LCD-3_5_ASM, not evidence of a P4 circuit.
